name: comind
description: Team-shared AI context. One command pins RTK, Caveman, GSD phase discipline, graphify and LSP verification for 12 languages, then tells you which files to commit.
_scopeNote: COMMANDS ONLY, deliberately. The caveman-gsd skill and the comind-gate hook are PROJECT-scoped: `comind setup` copies them from templates/team/ into the repo's .claude/ and they are committed, so the team shares one pinned contract. Omitting them here is necessary but NOT sufficient — Claude Code auto-discovers top-level skills/ and hooks/ directories by convention regardless of this manifest, which is why neither directory exists at the package root.
